digest.title: Comet NEOWISE Rising over the Adriatic Sea
digest.summary: This sight was worth getting out of bed early. Just over four years ago, Comet C/2020 F3 (NEOWISE) rose before dawn to the delight of northern sky enthusiasts awake that early.
